title: Shinonome Ena — A Cancelled Message〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
That was nice...
What time is it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And I have to go to school today.
Such a pain...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan, Amia, are you free to talk right now?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<What do you mean, Morning?
Did you just wake up, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So? Anyway, K...
You want to talk to us about something...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Ah...
So Yuki went to school after that...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And she collapsed at the park after making everything worse?!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha...
So she's sleeping at your place right now, K?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. She definitely seems much worse compared to yesterday...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Geez, she goes to school like an idiot and makes K clean up her mess.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. She took some medicine and it seems to be working, so she seems to have improved a little.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<How are you handling things, K?
Are you keeping her hydrated and stuff...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I've been keeping her forehead cool with a damp towel too. Also, I made her some apple sauce and she had some of it just now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Is there anything else that you think I should be doing?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<That's usually about it but...
Lemme see... “How to treat a cold”...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I can't really say either...
But I do remember someone saying that it's good to keep your neck and armpits cool.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, this site mentions that too for when someone's running a high fever.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And how you should, “Wipe off sweat at regular intervals.”>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Because sweat apparently robs your body of heat and can make a cold worse.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So it's okay to cool her neck area, but not so much the rest of her body.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, K, be careful not to catch whatever she has, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, you live alone, so who's gonna be there to take care of you if that happens?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hold on, are you trying to say that she should tell us where she lives so that you can rush over to help her?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But you can call me at any time if you ever need help. I don't care about cutting class and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, don't forget to call me too.
Leaving you in Enanan's hands sort of worries me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Thank you, Amia.
I promise to be careful.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, I have to go to school soon. If anything does happen, please call me, okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Thank you for meeting on such short notice, both of you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hehe. You're welcome.
For now, we'll leave Yuki in your hands...>
